title: GTA 6 vs GTA 5: Two Leads Instead of Three
short_title_options: GTA 6 makes you wait to switch characters 🔁 #GTA6 #Shorts
How to switch characters in GTA 6 (vs GTA 5) 🔁 #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
GTA 5 let you switch between Michael, Franklin and Trevor. GTA 6 has two leads, Jason and Lucia, and free switching opens in Chapter 2 in most guides: hold Right on the D-pad, then R1 (PS5) or RB (Xbox). Some missions lock you to one of them. No story spoilers.

Sources: GamesRadar, PowerPyx, KeenGamer, Rockstar Games.

facts_note: Nov 24: GTA 5 Michael/Franklin/Trevor (well documented); GTA 6 Jason Duval + Lucia Caminos (Rockstar); switch = hold Right on D-pad then R1/RB, free switching from Chapter 2 in most guides (GamesRadar, PowerPyx, KeenGamer); some missions lock a character. Re-check right before posting.
